notes: Independent review of 22 observations across 11 explicit country/economy mappings. Checked each World Bank country ID, ISO3, provider name, latest non-null year and numeric value, plus response completeness and the 2026-07-13 update metadata. All HDI observations refer to 2023 in HDR 2025; all selected life-expectancy observations refer to 2024, not 2025 or 2026. Confirmed the current UNDP documentation listing links to this CSV; opened UNDP terms, the WDI indicator's license and source metadata, the World Bank summary terms and its current dataset-specific terms. The recorded CC BY 3.0 IGO and CC BY 4.0 with World Bank additional terms, source acknowledgments, rounding notices and no-endorsement statements match these sources. This approves the candidate observations and their recorded source metadata only, not publisher endorsement, an aggregate quality-of-life score, causal passport benefits, rendering, deployment or later source revisions.
